0022600110.text: The Denver Nuggets (0-1) host the New Orleans Pelicans (0-2) in Denver's second game of the season, with the Nuggets 11th in the West and fifth in the Northwest, 1.5 games back, and the Pelicans 10th in the West and fourth in the Southwest, 2 games back. Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are out for Denver, and Alpha Diallo (wrist) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (knee), also day-to-day and a game-time decision. Denver won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 122-116 win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27.
